title: Full Business Website & E-Commerce Store — Launched in 3 Weeks
description: Mac Data Hub is a website for reselling Cheap Data Bundle. We designed and built a professional website with an integrated online store, product catalogue, and mobile payment checkout. The site went live in 21 days. Within the first month, they received 458 online orders from outside their local area — customers they would never have reached before. Visit the live website here: https://macdatahubgh.com

title: Social Media Platform with powered by in-built Crypto token ($DUYS).
description: The app was developed to help creators especially local creators to share their contents and earn through the engagements they earn from the app.

title: Church Website with Event Calendar & Sermon Archive
description: Designed and built a clean, mobile-first app for a local congregation — featuring an events calendar, downloadable sermon audio, an online giving page, and a simple CMS so the church admin can update content without any technical help.

title: Patient Appointment & Records Web App
description: Built a secure, browser-based appointment booking system with a patient records module — replacing a paper-based system that caused double-bookings and lost files. Staff can search, book, and update records from any device; patients receive SMS reminders automatically.

title: Security Audit & Endpoint Hardening for a Legal Firm
description: Conducted a full vulnerability assessment, found 14 critical gaps including unpatched endpoints and weak remote-access policies. Delivered a remediation roadmap and implemented endpoint protection, MFA, and staff phishing awareness training within six weeks.

title: On-Premise to Cloud Migration — Cut IT Costs by 40 %
description: Mensah Logistics was running ageing on-site servers with no offsite backup. We migrated their file shares, accounting system, and email to a cloud-hosted stack, implemented automated daily backups, and handed over a self-service admin dashboard their office manager can use without IT knowledge.

title: IT Strategy Roadmap for a Growing Medical Practice
description: The clinic's IT was a patchwork of consumer-grade equipment and ad-hoc solutions. We audited the environment, interviewed staff, and delivered a clear 18-month IT roadmap prioritised by risk and return — including a phased move to a healthcare-appropriate cloud stack.

title: 24 / 7 Managed Support — Friday-Night Outage Resolved by Morning
description: Asante Trading experienced a critical network failure on a Friday evening during a stock-taking exercise. Our on-call team responded within 20 minutes, diagnosed a failed core switch remotely, and had a replacement unit configured and operational before the next business day opened.

title: Data Cleanup, Centralisation & Automated Reporting Dashboard
description: Years of unstructured files spread across personal drives and USB sticks were costing the finance team hours each week. We audited, cleaned, and centralised all data, set up role-based access controls, built automated weekly backup jobs, and delivered a simple reporting dashboard in Google Looker Studio.

title: School-Wide Wi-Fi Deployment Across 8 Classrooms
description: Designed and installed a managed wireless network covering all teaching areas, the admin block, and the computer lab. Configured content filtering and a student/staff SSID separation so teachers maintain full bandwidth priority during school hours.

title: Secure Cloud Email & Document Management Setup
description: Migrated the pharmacy off a self-hosted, unpatched mail server onto Microsoft 365, configured email security policies, spam filtering, and set up SharePoint for document collaboration — enabling hybrid working for management staff.
